products.name: The Rajputana Bridle Belt
products.description: Cut from 4mm thick full-grain vegetable-tanned harness leather from Kanpur tanneries, finished with hand-burnished edges and a sand-cast solid antique brass roller buckle. Built to mold to your waistline and develop a rich amber patina over decades.
features: Full-grain harness leather 10-12 oz weight
Hand-stitched English bridle loop
Hand-burnished with natural beeswax and gum tragacanth
Solid brass teardrop buckle hardware with 2-year warranty

products.name: The Bifold Heirloom Folio
products.description: A classic 6-card bifold crafted from saddle-stitched Tuscan vegetable-tanned steer hide. Features dual hidden slip pockets, full-length billfold lined with raw sueded pigskin, and reinforced corner bevels.
features: 6 precision card slots with hand-cut thumb tapers
Two interior receipt pockets and currency compartment
Bonded nylon saddle stitching for fray-proof seams
Complimentary hot-stamping personalization in 24k gold foil

products.name: The Meera Structured Flap Purse
products.description: Architectural elegance meets traditional leathercraft. The Meera purse features a sculptured front flap, custom brass lock mechanism, and an interior divider with an invisible magnetic closure. Carried by the rolled leather top handle or detachable shoulder sling.
features: Saddle cognac pull-up full-grain leather with soft sheen
Micro-suede lining with zippered divider compartment
Protective brass base feet to elevate leather off surfaces
Includes organic balm conditioning care kit

products.name: The Devika Zip-Around Continental
products.description: Generously proportioned continental wallet fitted with an ultra-smooth Swiss RiRi brass zipper. Hosts 12 card slots, two accordion bill compartments, and a zippered coin pocket.
features: 12 card slots with RFID blocking shield layer
RiRi solid brass teeth with hand-stitched leather pull tab
Calfskin interior lining
Custom gold or blind deboss personalization available

products.name: The Padmavati Cinch Belt
products.description: A graceful 30mm waist belt designed to pair with tailored blazers and flowy linens. Hand-creased feathered edges with a rounded sculptural brass buckle.
features: Curved silhouette designed for high-waisted wear
Solid brass round buckle in satin gold finish
Vegetable-tanned calfskin with supple temper

products.name: The Himalayan Transit Rucksack
products.description: Engineered for intrepid modern explorers. Constructed from water-resistant wax-tempered heavy buffalo leather with padded ergonomic shoulder straps, a dedicated 16-inch padded laptop sleeve, and dual brass buckle quick-release storm flaps.
features: Padded 16-inch laptop compartment with waterproof YKK zip
Luggage trolley pass-through strap for seamless transit
Solid brass rivet reinforcement at all stress points
Complimentary 2-year hardware warranty registration included

products.name: The Viceroy Diplomat Briefcase
products.description: An imposing heritage briefcase inspired by colonial era state archives. Triple gusset structure with dual combination brass push locks, reinforced leather carry handle, and organized interior sleeves for contracts and digital tablets.
features: Triple bellows expanding interior with suede divider
Dual German precision key-locking push latches
Detachable full-leather shoulder strap with ergonomic pad
Eligible for lifetime complimentary leather reconditioning
